comments.author: NRK.Z
comments.body_html:
i appreciate the reply with every bit of information you gathered yourself, i can give you some insights on what gathered from your reply

so the first thing i can point out is that when running a higher resolution for most modern-ish cards, you will most likely see a performance uplift, why?

well to put it simply, it puts more load on your GPU than on your CPU, and this is a key thing to know that modern computer systems suffer running lower settings most of the time

and modern upscaling tech is very good now with DLSS/FSR running really well on most systems, now its never gonna be perfect for every system, thats why adjusting DLSS/FSR settings are very important

and the most important thing which you already have done is to optimize the AIs as much as you can while fitting your playstyle, this is something that is hard to provide with a plug-n-play config, i might make a future guide on that topic, though it will go into depth and i will have to think if its worthy to post since it will be a big project

now for things regarding overclocking, undervolting. this is honestly important to do, even if you dont like it, now to actually successfully do so you would need to research your exact card model, and its baselines of its boost clocks and base clock speeds for both the core and memory, and there are plenty of guides for many different cards out on YouTube and other platforms

but to achieve a good configuration, there are important things to know

a good information source is TechPowerUp to learn about your card

another thing to research is the power consumption of your system, importantly looking at your motherboard, GPU, CPU and PSU

your PSU will be important to check knowing its a good quality PSU to deliver stable power.

debloating drivers is another important thing to do, now im not sure how easy it is to do so on AMD cards, but you should check that up

for the overclocking vs undervolting topic, while overclocking is good for a specific uplift of performance, its not good for long term use as it will degrade the life time of the GPU, i would rather recommend running undervolt with a slight overclock, while lowering your voltage will lower your temps, power consumption and a performance uplift it will most likely also make your GPU last longer

now to give another insight on optimizations in general, debloating your operating system is important, especially in times where Microslop is completely degrading their own operating system, there are plenty “custom” OS for windows, but i wont promote any as thats outside of tarkov completely

and BSG doesnt care to optimize the game because they know very well its their game engine that is limited to support newer engine technologies, therefor to see them actually optimizing the game is close to 0 unless they truly care about it and make the hard jump to switch the game engine, this will also come with many flaws as some mechanics might not even be the same or possible to implement in newer game engines.

sorry for the essay of a message but its important to talk about the topic.
